title: PCROOT-1: polynomial odd-cell compilation in the integer-root banked sieve

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N). PCROOT-1 in proof.md, virtual.md and odd_partition.md uses the finite exhaustive tester for n<2^512, and otherwise k equal to the least odd integer at least ceil(n^(1/3)), z0=min{j:3j^2>=n}, z=z0+16*ceil(log2 n), ell=m=dl=z, the stated exact backward C_i recurrence and source cap, and the bounded polynomial token compiler and measured-basis bank. Its total sequential work T is O(2^((57735027/50000000)*sqrt(n))), with supported representative envelope B(n)=2^((57735027/50000000)*sqrt(n)) and exact growth index 1/2. This holds on every execution branch jointly with the other resource bounds and unconditional recovery of the entire secret with probability at least 1-2^(-7), for independent ideal source copies. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
